insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change is part of API version 2026-10. Previously, such queries would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should also review their existing queries to ensure they are not filtering by metafields that are not set up for filtering. The `metafield` object in the GraphQL Admin API has not changed, but the behavior of queries that filter by metafields has. Developers can use the `metafield` object to check if a metafield is set up for filtering before executing a query.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate results from GraphQL queries, as invalid metafield queries will now return errors instead of incorrect results.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy and reliability of GraphQL queries, which is important for developers who rely on the GraphQL Admin API to build their apps.
insight.code_example: query { products(metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" }) { edges { node { title } } } }
